purpose: Explain minsearch's scope and index types

required_facts.fact: Index uses TF-IDF over text fields.
VectorSearch uses precomputed embeddings and cosine similarity.
Filters include keyword, numeric and date ranges.
Appendable performance was improved with a benchmark loop.
Minsearch fits notebooks, prototypes and small automations.
SQLiteSearch or full search systems are recommended for larger data.

author_attribution: Present minsearch as Alexey's lightweight teaching and local-search library, not a universal replacement.
